name: BACH_0078
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged (tier 2) for invasive call [F1]; ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 orders are drafted pending confirmation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Unanimous classifier probability for Invasive |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (10% alpha; 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 64th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical image, no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (84%–90% similarity) [F5] | All five nearest neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (1.07, +0.54 contribution); 19/20 AI spot check [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 11) · ↑ invasive · Low benign score (+0.37 contribution); unreliable 0/20 AI spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 8) · context · Below-typical score (0.17, +0.36 contribution); 8/20 AI spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3) · ↑ invasive · Low benign stroma (0.25, +0.30 contribution); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Nuclear morphometry** (regions 0, 4, 11) · context · Size variation 100th percentile [F8], shape 95th [F9], area 0th [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 3 and 8 mimic stromal invasion in a benign lesion like contrast case BACH_0284 (83% similarity).
- Atypical cells remain duct-confined (region 10), or high benign epithelial fraction (82% [F10]) reflects non-invasive tissue.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 0, 4, 3**: Confirm true stromal invasion before releasing drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 orders.
2. **Regions 0, 4, 11**: Verify neoplastic nuclei given 100th-percentile size variation but small mean area (37.4 µm²).
3. **Region 10**: Check whether atypical cells are strictly duct-confined (score 0.60; region risk 84%).
